verdict.rationale: A probe confirms NVIDIA serves an llms.txt at developer.nvidia.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), which describes the developer portal. Several relevant docs pages are also served as markdown (.md), including the Video Codec SDK, cuML, CUDA-X data science and AI inference pages, so an agent can be pointed at agent-readable docs for the software stack behind this GPU. However, the llms.txt is portal-wide rather than specific to RTX PRO 6000, and the markdown version of the core CUDA Toolkit page returns 404. missing for 10: an RTX PRO 6000-specific llms.txt or agent docs, complete markdown coverage (cuda-toolkit.md is 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
